versions.changelog:
**交付规范重大调整：默认“单源三格式”、消除历史“双格式”表述矛盾。**

- 交付规则统一为默认三格式（PDF+DXF+DWG），DXF 为单一源，PDF与DWG均由DXF转换。
- 文档中所有“交付流程”“正式图纸交付”等历史“双格式”表述已修订为三格式单源同步回传。
- 不再保留 skill-card.md 说明，相关内容聚合至主文档。
- 版本号升级至 1.2.6。

**Added unified rendering workflow; now both PDF and DWG are generated from DXF source with new rendering considerations.**

- Default export changed: PDF and DWG outputs are now both converted from the DXF file for consistency.
- Added details about four critical rendering pitfalls in the generation process.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md from the repository.
- Updated documentation to reflect the new workflow and rendering notes.

gb-cad-figure 1.2.4 adds major image-to-CAD tracing/conversion capabilities.

- Removed obsolete: skill-card.md 文件

**Summary: Adds new scripts and Python tools for DXF font handling and figure generation.**

- Added three scripts: check_dxf_fonts.py for DXF font validation, dxf2dwg.sh for DXF to DWG conversion, and gb_figure.py for GB standard figure generation.
- Updated documentation in README.md and SKILL.md to reflect new features and tool usage.
- Improved workflow support for generating GB/T-compliant engineering drawings and CAD templates.

Initial release of gb-cad-figure

- Provides a reusable workflow for generating formal engineering drawings and CAD templates to Chinese GB/T standards.
- Supports A3 and other standard drawing frames, title blocks, line types, GB-compliant dimensioning, fonts, scale, technical notes, legends, and standardized layer management.
- Automates isometric/lathe body drawing, leader dimensions, centerlines, and special bottle-bottom arches.
- Outputs in PDF, DXF, and DWG formats; includes templates for CAD (.dwt) and handles font issues (e.g., SHX/TrueType for Chinese text).
- Specifies a strict delivery process: choose appropriate drawing size based on content, apply full GB workflow, enforce standards at every step.
- Includes detailed instructions, rules, and troubleshooting for text/font display, layer naming, and drawing configuration.
